Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  13 = 1 * 3
  22 = 2 * 2
  23 = 2 * 3
  33 = 3 * 3
  103 = 1 * 03
  202 = 2 * 02
  222 = 2 * 22
  301 = 3 * 01
  0000 = 00 * 00
  1123 = 11 * 23
  1211 = 12 * 11
  2333 = 23 * 33
  103202 = 103 * 202
  2222333 = 222 * 2333
  3010000 = 301 * 0000
